title: NURO finding things on the seafloor

tellings.quote: >> It seems like they might be finding things on the seafloor. >> Yep. They are

plain: A little-known secret US office that works on the ocean floor, called NURO, is said to be finding things down there. When Michels puts it to John S. Herrington, a former US Secretary of Energy, that "it seems like they might be finding things on the seafloor," Herrington answers: "Yep. They are." He gives no details, but the brief confirmation hints that unexplained objects may be turning up under the sea.
